europe_now.title: Serbian Leadership Defeat
europe_now.summary: Longtime Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić has conceded defeat following a parliamentary election outcome driven by a student-led protest movement. Citizens celebrated across Belgrade following the political shift.

sources.headline: 'Serbia is free': Belgrade erupts in celebration after Vucic's defeat
Elation across Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić concedes to student-led protest movement

europe_now.title: Impact on EU Deportation Flights
europe_now.summary: Regional conflicts involving the Iran war and Israeli airstrikes have significantly derailed thousands of European Union deportation flights. The disruptions highlight the broader security implications of Middle Eastern escalations on European migration policy.

sources.headline: [Exclusive] Iran war and Israeli airstrikes derail thousands of EU deportation flights

top_stories.title: Political Transition in Serbia
top_stories.summary: Student-led protests and a parliamentary poll culminated in the defeat and concession of long-standing Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić. Celebrations erupted across Belgrade as citizens responded to the unexpected political change.

top_stories.title: French Political Campaign Shifts
top_stories.summary: Recent opinion polling indicates shifting momentum among French presidential hopefuls ahead of the upcoming election. Edouard Philippe saw a decline in support, allowing other figures to gain ground amid domestic unrest.
